methods.notes: Exact-prefix evidence from the 2026-11-07 advertisement and the LOYPRO app's scan list. Do not add 0xFFF0 here: doing so would reactivate every unrelated FFF0-based spec as a candidate.

identification.notes: LOYPRO 2.1.04 explicitly accepts this prefix in its scan filter. LOY PLAY 1.7.15 and LOY SPACE 1.2.19 accept only YS/TL, so do not conflate the three app families. The digits after LOY have no proven model or resolution meaning.

device.name: LOY / LOYPRO LED Display
device.notes:
Candidate identification for LOY/LOYPRO LED matrix displays. The app evidence supports the same AA55 binary-TLV family as AUTOBABA, but this spec deliberately does not force that product's YS/TL identity or claim a model, geometry or working command session for a LOY-named unit.
`identify_only` remains the honest state until a read-only GATT enumeration and a device-information response establish the model, firmware, width, height and exact command dialect. The shared 0xFFF0 service is retained in `services` for post-connect use, never as an identification signal: unrelated LED panels, thermometers, battery monitors, OBD adapters and treadmills all advertise it.

openness.notes: The LOYPRO app (com.yskj.loypro) explicitly accepts advertised names beginning LOY, unlike the LOY PLAY and LOY SPACE app versions that accept only YS and TL. That prefix, not the widely shared 0xFFF0 service, is the scan-time discriminator for this candidate.

pairing.notes: The wider codec has an optional password capability, but no such requirement was observed. If enabled, use the owner's normal app flow rather than guessing or bypassing it.

credentials.notes: No account, Wi-Fi credential or pairing secret is established.

factory_reset.effect: No reset is established. Do not use a display-format or delete-all command as a pairing or identification probe.

methods.description: Match the LOY prefix, enumerate services and characteristics, then corroborate the AA55 family with a device-information reply. Full GATT properties are not yet known for the observed unit.
methods.name: Read-only LOYPRO identification

steps.action: Scan for a fresh LOY-prefixed advertisement and connect without persisting a stale address.
Enumerate GATT and confirm FFF2 is write-without-response and FFF1 is notify, if that is the layout offered.
Subscribe to FFF1 and request device/panel information using protocol_details.read_only_identification.
steps.expect: An AA55 reply identifying model, firmware, width and height; stop if the dialect differs.

setup.notes: No account or provisioning is established for the BLE display path. Start read-only: enumerate GATT, subscribe to FFF1 and use a source-derived information query only after the user has selected this LOYPRO candidate. Do not send another protocol's initialization.

rejoin.notes: Rediscover by the exact advertised name and, once confirmed, the expected characteristic layout. A previous address may be stale.

testing.notes: One 2026-11-07 advertisement from LOY5265115155 carried the LOY name and 0xFFF0, with no service-data or manufacturer record. It was not found again in two later windows, so GATT enumeration did not complete. No characteristic read, subscription, write, pairing, reset or firmware operation was performed. Model, geometry and the exact AA55 dialect remain unverified.

artifacts.description: Name and advertised 0xFFF0, RSSI -59 dBm; no manufacturer or service-data record retained. Address and raw payloads deliberately omitted. Later scans did not rediscover the name, so GATT discovery did not complete.

artifacts.artifact: LOYPRO com.yskj.loypro 2.1.04 and LOY PLAY com.yskj.loy 1.7.15
artifacts.description: Established that LOYPRO accepts LOY while the other app version accepts only YS/TL, and corroborated the FFF0/FFF2/FFF1 map and AA55 family. No vendor classes, methods, source paths or UI text are reproduced.
Independent LOY PLAY / YSKJ client with the same service map and AA55 framing. Tested another named device, not LOY5265115155.

features.notes: No fixed geometry is claimed. Read panel TLV 0x1b before rendering. Raw-GIF support on another YS-family backpack is not proof of compatibility with a LOYPRO unit.

family_evidence.not_evidence_for: Exact retail model, matrix geometry, raw-GIF compatibility, optional maintenance services or a successful command session on this unit.
family_evidence.transport_shape: AA55 framing, sequence, flags/mode, TLV payloads and little-endian additive checksum

read_only_identification.notes: Twenty-byte AA55 information query with example sequence 1, shared from the reviewed family codec and not transmitted during research. Subscribe to FFF1 first and use FFF2 without response only if that property is confirmed. Device-information TLV 0x0a carries identity/model/version; panel TLV 0x1b carries big-endian width and height. Stop if no valid AA55 reply arrives; do not try another protocol's initialization as a fallback.

tlv_length_encoding.extended_16: 82 LL LH: little-endian u16 length (256 and above)

remaining_unknowns: Full GATT properties and whether 5833ff, Nordic DFU or other maintenance services exist.
Actual model, firmware, width, height and whether the name's digits carry any serial/model semantics.
Whether this unit uses the exact AA55 TLV dialect and initialization sequence expected by LOYPRO.
Whether intermittent advertising means another central is holding the connection.

characteristics.name: Display notifications
characteristics.notes: Expected AA55 acknowledgements and TLV replies; subscribe before an information query.

get_device_info.description: Request device and panel information using the source-derived AA55 information query in protocol_details.read_only_identification.

characteristics.notes: Use response=False if the unit confirms this property; no write was attempted.

services.name: LOY display service (family evidence)
services.notes: LOYPRO uses this service for display commands, but 0xFFF0 is shared by many unrelated protocols and must not identify the device by itself. Full characteristic properties for LOY5265115155 are unknown.
